import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mpl_toolkits.mplot3d as mplot3d

# 1) upstream PR #14623 test_inverted_limits (post-fix assertions)
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.set_xlim(-5, 4)
ax.set_ylim(5, -3)
assert ax.get_xlim() == (-5, 4), ax.get_xlim()
assert ax.get_ylim() == (5, -3), ax.get_ylim()
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_ylim(10, 1)
assert ax.get_ylim() == (10, 1), ax.get_ylim()
print("1) upstream test_inverted_limits assertions: OK")

# 2) normal (non-inverted) set_ylim on log still works
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_ylim(1, 10)
assert ax.get_ylim() == (1, 10), ax.get_ylim()
assert not ax.yaxis_inverted()
print("2) normal-order log set_ylim: OK")

# 3) autoscale on log after plot still sane (ascending)
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 10, 100], [1, 10, 100])
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.autoscale_view()
assert ax.get_ylim() == (1, 100), ax.get_ylim()
assert ax.get_xlim() == (1, 100), ax.get_xlim()
print("3) log autoscale: OK")

# 4) logit scale inversion
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.set_yscale("logit")
ax.set_ylim(0.9, 0.1)
assert ax.get_ylim() == (0.9, 0.1), ax.get_ylim()
print("4) logit inverted set_ylim: OK")

# 5) 3D axes inverted limits
fig = plt.figure()
ax = mplot3d.Axes3D(fig)
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_ylim(10, 1)
assert ax.get_ylim3d() == (10, 1), ax.get_ylim3d()
ax.set_zlim(5, 1)
assert ax.get_zlim3d() == (5, 1), ax.get_zlim3d()
print("5) 3D inverted log ylim / zlim: OK")

# 6) singular identical limits still expand (warning path)
import warnings
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.set_yscale("log")
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    ax.set_ylim(5, 5)
assert ax.get_ylim() != (5, 5)
print("6) identical-limits expansion: OK ->", ax.get_ylim())

print("ALL REGRESSION CHECKS PASSED")

cat >> notes.md <<'EOF'

## 2025-11-02 fix: axis inversion lost on log/logit scales (mpl #14623)
- Cause: set_xlim/set_ylim (and Axes3D equivalents) call locator.nonsingular + limit_range_for_scale, which reorder/expand and can flip an inverted (vmin>vmax) interval; base Locator.nonsingular also passed increasing=False.
- Fix (matches upstream PR #14623 exactly; diff blob hashes identical): remember `swapped = lo > hi` before the calls, re-swap after; drop `increasing=False` in Locator.nonsingular. Files: lib/matplotlib/axes/_base.py, lib/matplotlib/ticker.py, lib/mpl_toolkits/mplot3d/axes3d.py.
- Verified: A/B pristine-vs-fixed on this tree (borrowed py3.12 .so from matplotlib-20488-nopanel build dir, PYTHONPATH=lib, Agg). Pristine: log ylim (1.0,100000.0) inverted=False; fixed: (100000.0,1.0) inverted=True. Upstream test_inverted_limits assertions, logit, 3D, identical-limits expansion all pass. No tests touched; working tree has only the 3-file fix.
EOF
tail -5 notes.md
